title_sq: SHESIM TRUALL DHE SHTEPI PRIVATE NE RRUGEN BARDHYL!
description_sq:
Ne rrugen Bardhyl prane gjimnazit Andon Zako Cajupi ofrojme per shitje truall me siperfaqe 300 m2.
Ne 90 m2 te saj eshte e ndertuar nje shtepi 1 kateshe me 2 dhoma gjumi aktualisht e banueshme.
Aksesi me rrugen kryesore, fasilitet e zones gjithashtu qetesia qe ofron e bejne nje mundesi mjaft te mire si per banim ashtu dhe per investim.
Mund te shfrytezohet per ndertimin e nje hoteli te vogel gjithashtu per perdorim zyrash, klinike etj.
Prona disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor.
title_en: PRIVATE LAND AND HOUSE FOR SALE IN BARDHYL STREET!
description_en: On Bardhyl street, near the Andon Zako Cajupi high school, we offer for sale a plot of land with an area of ​​300 m2. In its 90 m2, a 1-story house with 2 bedrooms is currently habitable. The access to the main road, the facilities of the area as well as the peace it offers make it a very good opportunity for both residence and investment. It can be used for the construction of a small hotel, also for the use of offices, clinics, etc. The property has regular mortgage documentation.
